concept: Cognito identity pools: temporary credentials for mobile users
tests: How to give mobile app users signed in via a social IdP temporary, limited AWS credentials without embedding keys.
expected: Amazon Cognito identity pools exchange IdP tokens for temporary credentials via STS. Triggers: "mobile app", "social identity provider", "temporary, limited-privilege credentials".
why_not: IAM users with access keys — long-lived secrets in the app; KMS grants — access to keys; Directory Service — managed directories.
